answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks through verifiable proof-of-space-time audits. Participants commit cryptographic table plots to local drives, answering unpredictable lookups within tight latency windows. Adversaries chasing validation nectar cannot forge lookup proofs on the fly, forcing attackers to provision a physical glacier of persistent storage sectors per identity. However, continuous audit reads and heavy plotting overhead penalize resource-constrained honest nodes.
